gre_general.value: The GRE is required for the PhD in Mechanical Engineering - Engineering Mechanics, except for online students and Michigan Tech undergraduates per the program page.
gre_general.quote: Currently, five programs require the GRE: MS and PhD in Computer Science, MS in Cybersecurity, PhD in Biomedical Engineering, PhD in Mechanical Engineering - Engineering Mechanics

also.quote: GRE (waived for online students and Michigan Tech undergrads)

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page gives no funding rule.

entry_route.value: Admission is possible after a bachelor's (60 credits) or a master's (30 credits).

notes: The department page lists recommended IELTS 7.0 and TOEFL 4.5; these are recommendations, so the university minimum (IELTS 6.5) is kept.
